---
title: Get started
---

![](assets/package-mark.png){.homepage-logo fig-alt="weightedstate logo"}

`weightedstate` implements a weighted Aalen–Johansen estimator for
time-to-event data. In the single-event setting, this estimator reduces to a
weighted Kaplan–Meier estimator.

The package provides one core function, `weighted_aalen_johansen`, for
single-event survival and competing-risk settings.

## Installation

With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
uv add weightedstate
```

Alternatively, with pip:

```bash
pip install weightedstate
```

## Single-event example

```{python}
import polars as pl
from weightedstate import weighted_aalen_johansen

times = pl.Series([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
reals = pl.Series([1, 0, 1, 1, 0])
weights = pl.Series([0.5, 1.5, 0.8, 1.2, 0.9])

weighted_aalen_johansen(times, reals, weights)
```

## Competing-risk example

```{python}
times = pl.Series([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
reals = pl.Series([1, 0, 1, 2, 0])
weights = pl.Series([0.5, 1.5, 0.8, 1.2, 0.9])

weighted_aalen_johansen(times, reals, weights)
```
